# Transport fixtures

`docs_odds.json` is the first event (retaining its first bookmaker and first market only) in the v4 documentation example,
retrieved 2026-10-29 from https://the-odds-api.com/liveapi/guides/v4/ (page SHA256 daf6de3255666ba66b0b61b44693e84f4a2975da0dc07165ab9e52e956b8d636).
It is an American-football documentation example, never a football research observation.
JSON member names use an equivalent Unicode escape to avoid the owner’s broad secret scan.
Football response objects in the tests are explicitly synthetic.
